summary: Iteration 179 - Dragon Chart History Feature Testing Complete. All features working correctly: POST /api/birth-chart/dragon-chart/save auto-saves for authenticated users, GET /api/birth-chart/dragon-chart/history returns saved items sorted recent-first, DELETE /api/birth-chart/dragon-chart/history/{chart_id} soft-deletes history items. Frontend Dragon Chart tab auto-saves on calculate for logged-in users, history panel shows item summary (birth input + axis + chinese profile), View loads selected chart, Delete removes from list.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend dragon chart history endpoints correctly implemented with proper authentication checks
POST /api/birth-chart/dragon-chart/save returns chart_id, birth_input, natal_chart, dragon_head_tail_chart, chinese_dragon_chart, generated_at, saved_at
GET /api/birth-chart/dragon-chart/history correctly filters by user_id and is_deleted, sorted by saved_at descending
DELETE endpoint uses soft-delete pattern (is_deleted flag) which is good for data recovery
Frontend DragonChartPanel.jsx correctly checks isAuthenticated before showing history panel
Auto-save logic correctly uses /save endpoint for authenticated users and /calculate for guests
History items display all required summary data: birth date/time/location, karmic axis, chinese zodiac animal/element
View and Delete buttons have proper data-testid attributes for testing
seed_data_creation: None - tests create their own dragon chart history items
